rationale: Vehicle was damaged in a collision caused by another driver; policyholder is claiming for damage to their own vehicle and personal injury from the accident.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was totaled in a rear-end collision on Route 9 when struck by another vehicle at ~35 mph with no braking. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is on the police report. Vehicle is a total loss and requires expedited assessment.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
